messages:
noah (DataViz): dropping a quick proposal 1: a "compact compare" matrix for model latency. each row = model, left = p95 sparkline, middle = throughput microbars, right = tiny heatstripe. expands to full panel with variance band and sampling knob. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-compare-matrix

jake (Design): nice layout. question: do we show p95 band inline or only in expanded view? band helps show volatility but is noisy in small rows.

noah (DataViz): thought was single p95 line in compact, band on expand. also consider an affordance that toggles band on inline across desktop wide screens.

sam (Eng-Frontend): agree for perf. inline band across many rows can cause repaint churn. we'll render band as CSS gradient overlay if needed, otherwise single line + hover detail. expand will lazy-load full SVG heatmap + band.

anya (A11y): accessibility: ensure each row exposes raw numbers via a hidden table row or an "Open data" button. heatstripe must have a grid fallback for screen readers. color scale must be perceptually uniform and not rely on hue alone.

li (Eng-ML): backend can return `sample_rate`, `sample_count`, and `sample_confidence`. also can tag whether sampling is prefix or uniform. recommend UI show an explicit "sampleing knob" state: Auto, 100%, 10%, 1%. we can also return `variance_band` arrays that frontend can render when toggle on.

maria (Product): copy: compact label ideas: 1) icon-only sample indicator with tooltip; 2) tiny text "s: auto". prefer icon-only to keep rows tight. expanded panel should show descriptive copy: "Sampling reduces cost; low sample size may hide rare spikes."

jake (Design): for the sampling control microcopy in the panel: label "Sampling" and microcopy underneath: "Adaptive by default. Override to view full traffic." Keep it short. For icon tooltip: "Sampling: adaptive (~12%)".

sam (Eng-Frontend): micro-implementation: icon-only on compact; on hover show full tooltip. for keyboard users, icon must be focusable and open tooltip via space/enter. expand panel gets a persistent dropdown.

anya (A11y): tooltip must be accessible and not rely on hover. use an aria-describedby approach and ensure tooltip text is reachable via keyboard focus. announce changes to sampling via aria-live region when user changes the value.

li (Eng-ML): small API note: we'll provide `sample_estimate_min` and `sample_estimate_max` so frontend can show a conservative range like "~8-12%". we'll also flag `low_sample_warning` when sample_count < 200.

katie (PM): rollout: behind feature flag `compact_compare_v1`. metrics: expand_rate, sampling_override_rate, and incidents where p99 is missing. plan: internal beta -> SRE -> gradual org rollout.

jake (Design): visual nit: heatstripe colors should align with our severity palette but use luminance variation for accessibility. spacing: reduce row gap on dense mode. Add keyboard-only view toggle in header to switch to a table view for power users.

noah (DataViz): table mode idea is good for power users and a11y. can present percentile columns per row when toggled. also propose a quick-search to filter models by name or latency threshold.

sam (Eng-Frontend): quick-search is doable; will need an aggregated index endpoint to avoid N queries. performance budget: compact matrix should render < 200ms for 50 rows. canvas for heatstripe + virtualized list for rows.

anya (A11y): table view must include proper column headers and allow keyboard sorting. ensure aria-sort is present and default sort is p95 desc. Also include an exposed summary at top: "Showing X models, Y sampled" so screen reader users get context.

li (Eng-ML): will add `total_models`, `sampled_models_count`, and `sample_window_ms` to payload. frontend can compute whether p99 is reliable per model.

maria (Product): copy decision: compact icon tooltip = "Sampling: adaptive (~10%)". if sample_estimate range present show "(~8-12%)". low-sample inline note when <5%: "Low sample 1: p99 may be unreliable."

jake (Design): add microcopy for expand CTA: "Details" on desktop, and chevron-only on mobile. ensure expand uses aria-controls to point to panel.

katie (PM): tracking: add analytics events: `compact_expand`, `sampling_change`, `compact_toggle_table`, and `compact_filter`. li/sam add flags to API so we can attribute sampling changes to users.

ui-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood/preview/compact-compare/1777777777  feature_flag=compact_compare_v1

noah (DataViz): next steps: jake to finalize visuals, anya to draft the a11y microcopy and announce strings, sam to prototype virtualized list & canvas heatstripe, li to add sample fields to API. target: ship internal beta next Wednesday. thanks all. :thumbsup:
